text: メールを　とると　メッセージが　なくなりますが　よろしいですか？

structure.jp: メッセージが　なくなりますが
structure.en: the message will be lost, but

patterns.name: 〜と (if)
patterns.explanation: と after a verb says that when one thing happens, the next thing follows. とると = 'if you take'.

patterns.name: 〜が (but)
patterns.explanation: が at the end of a clause means 'but' and leads into the next part. なくなりますが = 'it will be lost, but'.
